title: MasterSelfLearn — Autonomous Evidence-First Research Engine
description: Autonomous, evidence-first research engine that runs on a timer with no manual input: .github/workflows/think.yml fires on a */30 * * * * cron, reads official public data, appends to a claims ledger, regenerates the site and documentation and commits its own output, so a cycle that reads nothing still publishes and says so. A cycle is seven stages, each a separate module that can fail without stopping the others — a failed stage becomes an entry in the irregularity register and the cycle still publishes. Figures below are the repository's own regenerated AUTO:COUNTS block at commit 86cb822, cycle 25, generated 2026-09-23T01:42:26Z: 22,070 accepted claims in the ledger (6,963 under the schema-v2 strict trace contract and 15,107 under the legacy contract reported but not upgraded; 14,570 captured from accepted source reads, 7,477 derived by recorded arithmetic and 23 negative proofs of absence), 0 claims rejected by the evidence gate, 2,294 derived claims rechecked this cycle with 0 that no longer recompute, 163 topics in the library (6 new), 416 published insights, 1,110 forecasts issued this cycle and 655 scored against outcomes, 28 ideas in the competition with 1 promoted, 27 open irregularities (1 new), 31 registered sources of which 28 are verified by a recorded live read and 3 are currently blocked, 63 reads ok against 4 failed this cycle out of 67 planned with 0 refused by the cap, 3,346 forecasts waiting for an observation, 0 that can never be scored, 2,155,278 bytes read, and 0 manual inputs required. data/irregularities.json at the same timestamp records 123 irregularities registered in total — 6 critical, 72 warn and 45 info — of which 27 are open, 96 resolved and 21 standing, where standing means a structural limit that deliberately does not auto-resolve. The 350-test suite was executed in this audit and passed (350 passed in 13.40s).

flags: This entry was published as 'MasterSelfLearn — Empty Placeholder Repository' from the 2026-09-21 audit, when the repository was one commit holding a single 15-byte README created twenty seconds after SelfLearn's (IRR-71). It is now a 42-commit, 111-file engine with a seven-stage pipeline, a claims ledger, three GitHub workflows and a 350-test suite. The placeholder description had become flatly false and is rewritten here from the repository's own files. IRR-84.

Every number in this description has a shelf life of at most 30 minutes, by design: the counts block is regenerated by msl/pipeline.py on every cron cycle and the README states that 'Quoting any figure outside this block means quoting something the next cycle has already superseded'. The repository moved from fe488ed to eda549e (cycle 24) while this pass was reading it. Treat all figures as cycle-24 values at 2026-09-22T23:43:29Z, not as current ones.

The ledger's own honesty split is published rather than collapsed into one total: of 20,947 accepted claims only 5,840 satisfy the schema-v2 strict trace contract, while 15,107 remain under the legacy trace contract and are reported but not upgraded. A reader who quotes 20,947 as strictly-traced claims would be overstating the evidence by roughly a factor of 3.6.

Forecast scoring is bounded and says so: 717 of 1,056 forecasts issued this cycle have been scored against outcomes, 2,891 are waiting for an observation, and 0 are recorded as can never be scored. Sources are similarly graded — 28 of 31 verified by a recorded live read, 3 currently blocked, 0 never probed — and 21 standing irregularities are structural limits the owner is meant to keep seeing rather than transient failures that auto-resolve.
The root of the repository is the published site (index.html plus 12 further HTML pages, app.js and styles.css) and Pages publishes from main /, so this entry classifies as app.
